text:
Mira Chen: Quick update before we kick off  running a 2-min stream/record check. If anything looks flaky we'll swap order to do roadmap first.

DeployBot: :information_source: Stream health check: CONNECTED -> 10:55:00 UTC, Recorder status: OK -> 10:55:02 UTC.

Priya Nair: Heads up I can see some dropped frames on the stream preview (pixelation around slides). Is bandwidth throttling on the presenter VM a thing?

Evan Brooks: Possibly. `tc qdisc show dev eth0` shows a fq_codel qdisc but no explicit rate limits. Could be CPU saturation from background backups. Checking `top` now.

Oliver Ruiz: On the recorder host: disk i/o iowait at 28%. `du -sh /var/recordings` -> 480G used (quota 500G). Collector temp files present: `/var/recordings/tmp/upload-*`. I'll purge old tmp files.

Mira Chen: Please purge and confirm. If we still see issues, fallback plan: start Zoom fallback + local OBS capture. Priya, can you grab local laptop capture if we need it?

Priya Nair: Yep I have a 2nd machine. I'll be on standby with OBS scene named "AH-Backup".

DeployBot: Recorder note: orphaned segments removed (N=12). Available space after cleanup: 42GB. Status: RECORDER=DEGRADED, STREAM=OK, RECORDING=TRUE.

Evan Brooks: CPU on the presenter VM at 95% from a `node` process (analytics job). I'll kill the analytics job now: `pkill -f analytics-ingest && systemctl restart presenter`.

Priya Nair: Tested mic levels on backup laptop  gain at 70% and using USB mic. Video capture to local SSD (fastwrite) configured.

Oliver Ruiz: Mirror upload to S3 showing intermittent 502s again. We've set retry policy to 5x `--retry 5 --backoff 2s`. If S3 keeps failing we'll need to archive locally and push after the meeting.

Mira Chen: OK switch agenda: product roadmap first, then org updates. Team, ping any live Qs in this thread during the talk and Haley will collect timestamps. If audio/video drops we will: 1) publish notes + slides immediately, 2) re-record demos and add as clips.

Haley Rivera: I'll run live notes in #all-hands-notes and add minute marks. Also will keep a short list of unanswered Qs for leadership to address post-meeting.

Priya Nair: Small request to presenters: please avoid animations on slides if streaming jitter persists  they exacerbate frame drops. PDF is safe fallback.

Evan Brooks: Presenter VM now at 12% CPU after killing job. Stream preview looks smooth again.

DeployBot: Recorder auto-archive to S3 queued (N=1). Current metrics: write_latency=120ms, drop_rate=0.2%.

Mira Chen: Thank you. Quick TL;DR of action owners before we start: Oliver (disk & uploads), Priya (OBS standby + backup capture), Evan (presenter VM health), Haley (notes & timestamps). I'll introduce roadmap and take live Qs here.

Priya Nair: If anyone in the audience wants to ask a live question and you don't see your comment on stream, drop it here with the prefix `Q:` and we'll surface it.

Mira Chen: Kicking off in 60s  presenters queued. If recording later shows gaps we'll publish a summary within 24 hours and follow-up clips as needed. :rocket:
